attention_diagnostics.attention_coefficient_scale_formula: stored c~_r (static coefficients or query bias b) start at r! times the represented value; attention uses c_r = c~_r / r!
attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: sum_(i<=t) sum_(r<=8) c_r(x_t) (s_ti + beta_r(t,i))^r v_i, s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k); c(x_t) = b + (a/r!)*tanh(x_t W) per layer/head, W initially N(0, 0.0395285^2) per entry, a initially 0, b_r initially 1/r!; x_t is the activation after the block input RMSNorm; order r = 1..8 reads its own biased score and order 0 is unshifted (beta_0 = 0): beta_r(t,i) = score_bias_offset_r per layer/head/order, initially 0; the shifted powers are evaluated directly, never expanded into unshifted powers, and a positive biased score does not imply a positive weight, since the coefficients are signed, then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <RoPE(g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps)), RoPE(g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps))> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero

cancellation.pair_formula: sum_r |T_r| / |sum_r T_r| over causal pairs whose kernel sum_r T_r is nonzero
cancellation.value_formula: sum_r ||o_r|| / ||sum_r o_r||, o_r = sum_(i<=t) T_r(t,i) v_i, over rows whose output is nonzero

score_biases.note: z_r = s_ti + beta_r(t,i) > 0 does not imply a positive weight: the coefficients c_r are signed; measured by the blocked reference of the same kernel, forward only

order_terms.formula: T_r = c_r(x_t) G_r(t,i) (s_ti + beta_r(t,i))^r, T_0 = c_0(x_t) G_0(t,i), over causal pairs; row_share is the mean over rows of each order's share of sum_r sum_i |T_r|

shifted_score_histogram.bins: underflow (z < -16), [e, e + 1) for each edge e < 16, overflow (z >= 16)
